name: Fruiting habit
description: Whether a caneberry cultivar fruits on first-year canes (primocane, fall-fruiting / everbearing) or second-year canes (floricane, summer-fruiting), or both. The primary variety-differentiating trait for raspberry and blackberry breeding programs; has no equivalent in blueberry, which does not have this two-year cane growth pattern. Added as part of the multi-berry portability audit (2026-08-20) -- the existing 10 trait entities were all derived from the blueberry-only pilot and describe measurable postharvest/agronomic characteristics, not this categorical growth-habit distinction.
